name: alpha-omega
_language_policy: follow_user = reply in the language the user writes in; `language` is only the fallback when the user's language is ambiguous (e.g. empty prompt, code-only). Set to 'force_config' to always use `language`.
description: CONFIG = the control panel. The agent reads this FIRST. It declares which AI-org folder to read (ai_org), which stacks are active (switch.stacks), which MCPs to use (mcp), which files are blocked (blocked_files), which actions are allowed (actions), and which scripts may run (scripts).

mcp.message: Check every server in `servers` is connected BEFORE planning work that needs it. If one is missing or unauthenticated: do NOT improvise, do NOT work around it, do NOT ask the user what to do. Tell them how to connect it and wait: (1) `claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url>`, (2) restart the session so the config is picked up, (3) complete the OAuth flow if the server asks for it. Then resume the task from where it stopped.

templates.rule: Read-only reference. NEVER overwrite. SPECS: copy to a NEW file with a new name. MEMORY: see templates.memory_boundary.

memory_boundary.immutable: <harness>/memory/*.md — the TEMPLATE. Defines the FORMAT only. Never read as state, never written.
memory_boundary.live: <project>/<ai_org>/memory/*.md (e.g. .claude/memory/STATE.md) — YOUR state. Read it THERE first, write it THERE on consolidation. Same filenames, same path as installed: it never moves.
memory_boundary.install_contract: install.sh copies ONLY the title line + the traceability pointer into the project. The template body (warnings, dummy sections, next steps) is NOT copied — a project state file that carries 'DO NOT MODIFY' is a broken install.

scripts._authority: scripts.<name> is the SOLE gate for running `node scripts/<name>.js`. These are deterministic harness tooling (~0 tokens, fixed output) — they are NEVER subject to actions.power_execution. A disabled bash/shell power does NOT disable them.
scripts._invariant: switch.metrics=true => scripts.metrics=true. switch.feature_registry=true => scripts.features=true. Breaking this is a CONFIG ERROR: declare the conflict to the user and stop. Never resolve it by silently skipping the obligation.

power_execution._model: Powers are grouped by EFFECT, not by tool name. Reading and searching are safe. Mutating the filesystem, sending data out, and writing to a database are not. `bash` as a single boolean is obsolete: it conflated both.
power_execution._read_only_search: Allows grep, glob, find, ls, cat, head, tail, wc, jq — read-only invocations only. HARD LIMIT: it NEVER overrides blocked_files. A search whose target is a blocked file is forbidden even though it only reads (`grep KEY .env` exfiltrates just as well as `cat .env`).
power_execution._denylist: Blocked regardless of any power above. A command matching an entry is refused, not negotiated — even when the user asks. Escalate to the user instead of running it.
